The '''Hammer and Nail''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]. It was located a few blocks from the [[Orbital Defense Command Center]] and was a popular hangout for [[Troop/Legends|troops]] stationed at the center.<ref name="Annihilation" />
